scope: Fixed bare namespace constant call whose checked compiled primary is N\constant and fallback is global constant, with one raw exact __COMPILER_HALT_OFFSET__ string argument and no user-function target, owner, named send or pack. Partial dynamic-source behavior.
engine_route: Zend/zend_compile.c::zend_compile_ns_call emits INIT_NS_FCALL_BY_NAME. Zend/zend_vm_def.h checks the namespace function before global fallback; PHP_FUNCTION(constant) and zend_get_halt_offset_constant use the executed filename.
mechanism: At an authenticated CONFIG_INVOKE, bind the complete checked primary/fallback option, require the exact global fallback and no user target, then reuse the Source100 filename-local HALT_OFFSET value and HALT_ABSENT Error branches. Selected calls, fixed global calls, fixed defined, HALT_UNKNOWN and provider boundaries are unchanged.

validation.native_first: Four frozen namespaced originals were pinned CLI0 with exact stdout and empty stderr. The unchanged checked model accepted all four; three fallback calls returned Unsupported and the namespaced user-function shadow returned USER normally.
validation.changed_sources: Author main absent/present and user shadow pass exact against the preserved native bytes. A copied absolute child snapshot stopped before semantics in v3 and remains zero credit; the child-only v4 rebuilt that snapshot from unchanged source bytes and passes exact. Independent reviewer frozen four-source packet passes exact, including Error file/line/trace and child-local offset 89 with main absent.
validation.reached_state: Three author original-derived strict-SL fixtures pass 68+55+130=253 checks on 421 modules: actual fallback CONFIG_INVOKE, no user target, local HALT offset/absence, Error trace, provider and journal preservation, budget0/resume, and an admitted HALT_UNKNOWN projection that remains Unsupported. Independent frozen absent frontier passes 69 checks.
validation.regression: One original Source100 fixed-global main-present source remains checked normal with exact native output. The new helper requires nonempty namespace fallback, so the unchanged selected-call and fixed-defined guards remain disjoint.
validation.failed_attempts: First and second model cuts had a nested optional fallback binder that failed at the actual reached descriptor; both remain zero credit. The first reviewer diagnostic had a fixture variable elaboration error, also zero credit. Its corrected guard diagnostic isolated the binder as the only failing premise.

environment.resources: Author CPU4 native/baseline, changed-source, diagnostic, focused-state and regression runs fully reaped/released; reviewer CPU4 guard, frozen-source and reached-front runs fully reaped/released.

raw_artifacts.recovery: Run halt_namespace_sources.py --phase native then --phase model with one fresh output root. Run halt_namespace_protocol.py --sources SOURCE_ROOT --output FRESH_ROOT; --case selects one of three reached fronts. The original native root supplies exact source bytes and file snapshot. Use the archived reports for zero-credit failures and the independent frozen packet.
